== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 4 May 2024. The Facebook photo viewer names Chris Libey. A comment by Paul Schmitz quotes May the Fourth. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 88 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Richmond, Va). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/chris.libey. The uncropped original is a full-body photograph with an R2-D2 figure and a Star Wars Dark Side 1977 shirt; the lead crop is Libey alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Chris Libey portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Chris Libey Facebook portrait.jpg]].
